intent: DNS-over-TLS (stunnel-dot) comes up at every boot, dnsmasq has no ordering cycle, and the service checker stops expecting the removed pc_startup feature and finds the extracted repos under ~/src.
scope: linux_configuration/periodic_background check_and_enable_services.sh, services_units.sh, services_report.sh and their tests
Non-goal: the firewall, the blocklist feed, the guard warnings (compulsive-block, LeechBlock, workout-locker) this checker reports
changes: dnsmasq: bind-dynamic instead of bind-interfaces, so starting before enp6s0 exists no longer exits with 'unknown interface'
dnsmasq drop-in: drop After/Wants=network-online.target, which cycled with the stock Before=network-online.target
stunnel-dot.service: Wants=dnsmasq.service instead of Requires=, so one failed dnsmasq start no longer kills DoT until a manual restart
check_and_enable_services: remove check_startup_monitor (pc_startup was removed in 765fa925) and default HOSTS_BLOCKER/DW/WORKOUT_LOCKER repos to ~/src/<repo>

verification.command: pre-commit run --files <the 11 files> (shell-coverage-ratchet runs the suites in the jail)
vmbox: dnsmasq with interface=<absent>, bind-interfaces vs bind-dynamic; Requires= vs Wants= on a failing dependency
verification.evidence: bind-interfaces: DIED 'unknown interface lanx0'; bind-dynamic: survived, bound 10.199.0.1:5353 after the interface appeared; Requires=: inactive; Wants=: active
dnsmasq --test OK; stunnel-dot active on 10.8.0.1:853, TLSv1.3 Verification OK; DNS answers on 127.0.0.1 and 192.168.1.43; no network-online in dnsmasq After=

verification.command: sudo check_and_enable_services.sh --status (host) and vmbox diff against HEAD
verification.evidence: full run, no 'not found'; only diff vs HEAD is the removed PC Startup Monitor section

risks: bind-dynamic also listens on addresses that appear later on enp6s0 (intended)
stunnel now starts even if dnsmasq is down; queries fail until dnsmasq is back, which Restart=always plus the watchdog already handle
rollback: git revert this commit, then rerun setup_dns_blocker.sh setup and setup_dot_resolver.sh
Validate with: systemctl is-active dnsmasq stunnel-dot; setup_dot_resolver.sh --check
